text:
maria gonzalez: quick heads-up — I need to swap primary for this coming weekend. flying out friday night, so i'm asking for someone to take primary from Sat 2026-04-04 08:00 PDT -> Sun 2026-04-05 20:00 PDT. i'll stay secondary/monitoring from mobile. sorry for the short notice :sweat_smile:

aj park: i can take primary for most of that window. i have a calendar conflict early saturday morning (03:00-06:00 UTC) — can someone cover that 3h overnight slice? otherwise i can handle the rest.

trent hill: i can pick up the overnight slice (03:00-06:00 UTC) if aj is happy to be primary for the day/night outside that. no other conflicts.

sam malik: i can also cover the overnight chunk if needed, but trent already volunteered — happy to be backup.

oncall-bot: [automated] Incident INC-2026-17: paging rules active, severity=2, no customers currently impacted per last check-in (2026-04-02T16:12Z). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/triage

aj park: thanks trent — appreciate it. i'll set the temporary override on the PD schedule now and put notes in the runbook. can someone confirm i should route all PD pages to +1 (aj) for the listed window? want to avoid surprises.

maria gonzalez: yes pls route to aj for primary. i'll add a short note about known throttling experiment we're running (no user-facing impact, but noise on the model pool alerts) so dont escalate unless latency > 800ms or error rate > 3%.

aj park: copying the commands i'm using in case it's helpful for the rotation infra team:

```bash
# temporary override for the schedule (example)
pd schedules override <schedule-id> --start 2026-04-04T15:00:00Z --end 2026-04-05T03:00:00Z --user aj.park@redwood.com
# confirm current oncall
pd schedules show <schedule-id> | grep current
```

aj park: i also added the note in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-primary — under "weekend notes" — and included the experiment tag.

trent hill: confirmed i'll take 03:00-06:00 UTC (Sat). aj will be primary otherwise. sam will standby if anything overlaps.

sam malik: noted. will keep my phone on for 03:00-06:00 just in case — ping me in thread if you need to reassign on the fly.

maria gonzalez: massive thanks to you all. two quick follow-ups: 1) aj — can you add a short bullet in the runbook about escalation thresholds you want to use for this weekend? (latency/error rate thresholds and whether to page infra on-call) 2) trent/sam — please ack on PD when aj sets the override so the schedule reflects it.

aj park: will do — adding thresholds now. my suggested thresholds: latency p95 > 800ms OR error rate > 3% -> page infra-oncall; any customer-facing errors -> page on-call manager. adding the bullet and commenting on the PD override ticket.

oncall-bot: [automated] Schedule override created for aj.park@redwood.com (start=2026-04-04T15:00:00Z, end=2026-04-05T03:00:00Z). Ticket: PD-4719.

trent hill: acked the PD override.

sam malik: acked.

maria gonzalez: last note: there's an ongoing noisy alert from the quantization tests — not customer impacting but it spikes our alert counts. i've linked the mitigation steps in the runbook and pinned them here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mitigations#quant-noise

maria gonzalez: mitigation snippet pinned in runbook (copy):

```text
1) check pool health: /infra/pool-health (internal)
2) restart worker group gq-2 if mem > 80% and stuck queues > 5
3) if restart fails, failover to model-variant v2-quant-fallback (config path: /models/variants)
4) notify customers via #status if failover triggered
```

aj park: thanks, i'll follow that if noise spikes. trent — i'll handoff notes to you before i go offline friday.

maria gonzalez: great. aj confirmed as primary for the stated window (except 03:00-06:00 UTC which trent will cover). sam is standby. i'll update the weekly rotation doc and drop a comment on the incident ticket. thanks team :heart:

aj park: thanks all — i'll post a short summary here once the override is fully in place and mark the thread resolved for the schedule change.

oncall-bot: [automated] Thread update: PD-4719 status=open; action=override_applied; updated_by=aj.park@redwood.com

aj park: override applied and notes posted. closing this handoff thread for schedule change; keeping incident monitoring separate.

maria gonzalez: acknowledged. won't close the incident thread until we get a clean check-in tomorrow morning.

aj park: understood — i'll keep an eye.
